Every other entry keeps runn"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ader entry — matched by entry id, module name, or MCP `serverName`. Every other entry keeps running."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Two reload strategies are chosen per entry kind:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **`mcp-client` entries** respawn the MCP server child process on restart (picking up new server co"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"de on disk) and re-register its tools; sibling MCP connections are not affected.
- **in-process plug"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"in entries** get a **hard reload**: the Node ESM/CJS module caches for the entry and its local sourc"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"e files are busted, the entry is re-imported from disk, and its fibers are swapped onto the fresh mo"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"dule — the same technique `cordis-plugin-hmr`'s partial reload uses. Plugin code changes take effect"},{"id":"p6s6","text":" **without restarting the host**, and a failed re-import or re-apply rolls back to the previous code"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"**without restarting the host**, and a failed re-import or re-apply rolls back to the previous code."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> Built on the "everything is a plugin" architecture of DeepSeek Harness. The official repository do"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"es not accept external pull requests at the moment — per CONTRIBUTING.md, community plugins are publ"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ished independently and shared under the `dsh-plugin` topic."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install (auto-mount)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Since **v0.1.2** the package declares a `dsh.bundle`, so a single command installs the plugin **and*"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"* automatically mounts it:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"What happens under the hood:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"1. `dsh plugin` runs `pnpm add` inside the profile directory (`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/`).
2. On succ"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ess it reconciles the profile manifest: because `dsh-plugin-reload` declares `dsh.bundle` in its `pa"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ckage.json`, it is appended to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer list.
3. On the next harnes"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"s start the bundle layer is composed, and the plugin's own `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `plugin-re"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"load` entry — the tool appears in the model's tool list with **no manual patch editing**."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"To pick up a later version:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> Freshly published versions may be held back briefly by pnpm's `minimumReleaseAge` supply-chain pol"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"icy; an explicit version (`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-reload@0.1.x`) bypasses it."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Manual mount (alternative)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"If you install the package with plain `npm` (not via `dsh plugin`), or prefer an explicit patch row,"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" add it to your profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`, or a `--patch` overlay):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Restart the harness (or let profile-patch HMR pick it up). Keep either the bundle mount or the manua"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"l row — not both (a duplicate tool registration fails at load)."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"`reload_plugin` accepts:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Argument | Required | Meaning |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| `name` | yes | Entry id (preferred), module name, or MCP `config.serverName` of the entry to reloa"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"d |
| `mode` | no | `auto` (default) — hard reload for in-process plugins, fiber restart for mcp-cli"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"ent; `soft` — dispose and re-apply only (never picks up in-process code changes); `hard` — bust ESM/"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"CJS caches and re-import the entry code from disk |
| `dry_run` | no | `true` reports the single mat"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"ched entry and the strategy that would run, without restarting it |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Matching walks the Loader's non-group entries once: exact entry id first, then module name, then mcp"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"-client `serverName`. Zero matches fail with a bounded list of available entries; multiple matches f"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ail listing the candidate entry ids and change nothing. Group entries never match — restarting a sub"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"tree requires one call per leaf entry."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"A successful reload returns the entry id, module, optional `serverName`, previous and current fiber "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"phases, the strategy used, and a semantics note. A hard reload writes nothing back to the loader con"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"fig: the entry's options stay untouched, only its fiber is swapped onto the re-imported module."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- A DeepSeek Harness profile with the web (or headless) bundle, i.e. the standard `dsh` runtime with"},{"id":"p27s2","text":" `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader` available."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Brief tool outage during reload** — the reloaded entry's contributions (e.g. MCP tools) are unre"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"gistered between disposal and re-application; in-flight calls to those tools fail.
- **No group relo"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ad** — restarting a whole plugin subtree must be requested per leaf entry.
- **Hard reload covers th"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"e plugin's own code only** — dependencies in `node_modules` (e.g. `@deepseek-ai/*`, `ws`) are intent"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ionally not re-imported; changing those still requires a host restart. Module-level state of the rel"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"oaded plugin is re-evaluated (a fresh `import`), so plugins must not rely on top-level persistent st"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"ate surviving a reload.
- **Agent-facing only** — no browser/UI surface; the Settings plugin-invento"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"ry tab stays read-only."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
